housing: Harborough is a largely rural district in south Leicestershire, centred on the market towns of Market Harborough and Lutterworth, with large villages such as Broughton Astley, Kibworth and Fleckney and suburban villages on the edge of Leicester. Most homes are owner-occupied semis and detached houses, many on estates built since the 1990s, and private renting is well below the regional average. Older terraces and period houses in the town centres and village cottages make up much of the rest of the rented stock.
checkinTips: Period houses and terraces in Market Harborough and Lutterworth town centres: check sash windows, damp at the base of walls and the condition of rear yards.
Village cottages: record beams, low ceilings, open fireplaces and chimneys, uneven floors and any oil tank or septic tank.
Newer estate homes in Market Harborough, Lutterworth and Kibworth: note snagging still outstanding, meter readings and parking allocations.
Rural homes off the mains: photograph oil tank gauges, the boiler and any private water or drainage equipment.
Homes near the Welland and the Soar's tributaries: look for signs of past flooding or damp in ground-floor rooms.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems in a private let can contact Harborough District Council's environmental health (housing) team, after first reporting the problem to their landlord.
